mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox ( event_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, topic, kafka_key, payload, status, retry_count, created_at ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{topic}, #{kafkaKey}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb), 'NEW', 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id AS eventId, aggregate_type AS aggregateType, aggregate_id AS aggregateId, event_type AS eventType, topic, kafka_key AS kafkaKey, payload::text AS payload, status, retry_count AS retryCount, last_error AS lastError, to_char(created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') AS createdAt, to_char(sent_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') AS sentAt FROM outbox WHERE status = 'NEW' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox SET status = 'SENT', sent_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
